# Providers, hooks & utilities

Configuration, toasts, undo/redo, autosave, formatting and helpers.

[ConfigProvider](#configprovider) · [ToastProvider](#toastprovider) · [useHistory](#usehistory) · [useAutosave](#useautosave) · [useEditStore](#useeditstore) · [useTryList](#usetrylist) · [useCopy](#usecopy) · [useMedia](#usemedia) · [usePageTitle](#usepagetitle) · [useFormat](#useformat) · [useText, useLang](#usetext-uselang) · [Utilities](#utilities)

### ConfigProvider

Holds the live theme and site configuration, applies it as CSS variables, and exposes it through hooks. Wrap your app in it once.

```ts
import { ConfigProvider, useConfig, useSite } from '@/kit/context/ConfigContext'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `saved` *(required)* | `AppConfig` |  | The configuration the project ships with. Build it with `mergeConfig(json)` so missing values fall back to defaults. |
| `saveEndpoint` | `string` | `'/__config/save'` | Dev-only URL that persists the configuration to disk. |
| `children` *(required)* | `ReactNode` |  | Your app. |

```tsx
const SAVED_CONFIG = mergeConfig(rawJson)
bootstrapTheme(SAVED_CONFIG)   // before first render: no flash of default colors
<ConfigProvider saved={SAVED_CONFIG}><App /></ConfigProvider>

const { config, setConfig, dirty } = useConfig()
const { locale, currency } = useSite()
```

- The configuration shape is in `kit/theme/schema.ts`. See docs/theming.md for every setting.
- Unsaved edits are kept in this browser as a draft; `dirty` is true while the live config differs from `saved`.

### ToastProvider

Transient messages in the bottom-right corner. `useToast().push(...)` shows one; it can carry a button such as Undo.

```ts
import { ToastProvider, useToast } from '@/kit/context/ToastContext'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` *(required)* | `string` |  | push: bold first line. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  | push: smaller text. |
| `tone` | `'info' \| 'success' \| 'error'` | `'info'` | push: icon and color. |
| `duration` | `number` | `4500` | push: milliseconds before it disappears; 0 keeps it until dismissed. |
| `key` | `string` |  | push: a new toast with the same key replaces the old one, so repeated actions do not stack up. |
| `action` | `{ label: string; onClick: () => void }` |  | push: a button inside the toast. The toast closes after it is clicked. |

```tsx
const toast = useToast()
toast.push({ tone: 'success', title: 'Saved', key: 'save', action: { label: 'Undo', onClick: undo } })
```

- At most four toasts show at once. The region is `aria-live="polite"`.

### useHistory

State with undo and redo. Every `set` that changes the value is one undo step (100 are kept).

```ts
import { useHistory } from '@/kit/hooks/useHistory'
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `initial` *(required)* | `T \| (() => T)` |  | Starting value, or a function that creates it. |

```tsx
const { value, set, undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo, reset } = useHistory({ name: '' })
set((prev) => ({ ...prev, name: 'Ada' }))
```

- Returns `value`, `set`, `undo`, `redo`, `reset(value)`, `canUndo` and `canRedo`. `undo` and `redo` are stable references.

### useAutosave

Debounced autosave with a visible status and an on/off preference remembered in this browser.

```ts
import { useAutosave } from '@/kit/hooks/useAutosave'
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` *(required)* | `T` |  | The current value; saving is rescheduled whenever it changes. |
| `dirty` *(required)* | `boolean` |  | True when the value differs from what was last saved. |
| `save` *(required)* | `() => void` |  | Persists the value. |
| `storageKey` *(required)* | `string` |  | The on/off choice is stored under `<storageKey>.autosave`. |
| `delay` | `number` | `900` | Milliseconds to wait after the last change. |

```tsx
const { status, savedAt, enabled, setEnabled, saveNow } = useAutosave({ value: edits, dirty, save: persist, storageKey: 'budget' })
```

- `status` is "saving" while a change waits, "saved" afterwards, and "unsaved" when autosave is switched off.

### useEditStore

Everything an editable table needs besides its rows: edits loaded from this browser, undo and redo, autosave, and props for DataGrid.

```ts
import { useEditStore } from '@/kit/hooks/useEditStore'
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `storageKey` *(required)* | `string` |  | Where edits and the autosave preference are stored. |

```tsx
const { edits, history, apply, saveProps } = useEditStore('budget')
const value = edits[editKey(row.id, 'jan')] ?? row.jan
<DataGrid onEdit={apply} history={history} save={saveProps()} … />
```

- Edits are a flat map `{ "rowId|column": value }` (see `kit/lib/edits.ts`); the source rows are never mutated.
- `apply(changes, columnPart?)` records a batch as one undo step; `columnPart` maps a column id to the key part.

### useTryList

State for a “Try it” checklist: which steps are done, and whether the card is shown (remembered in this browser).

```ts
import { useTryList } from '@/kit/hooks/useTryList'
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `storageKey` *(required)* | `string` |  | Where the shown/hidden choice is stored. |
| `eventToTask` *(required)* | `Partial<Record<GridEvent, string>>` |  | Maps what DataGrid reports (edit, sort …) to the step it completes. Define it outside the component. |

```tsx
const tryout = useTryList('my-try', { edit: 'edit', sort: 'sort' })
<DataGrid onInteraction={tryout.onInteraction} … />   // tryout.mark('month') ticks a custom step
```

### useCopy

Copies text to the clipboard (with a fallback) and reports a temporary “copied” state.

```ts
import { useCopy } from '@/kit/hooks/useCopy'
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reset` | `number` | `1600` | Milliseconds `copied` stays true. |

```tsx
const { copied, copy } = useCopy()
<button onClick={() => copy(url)}>{copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy link'}</button>
```

### useMedia

Tracks a CSS media query.

```ts

```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |

| `query` *(required)* | `string` |  | A media query such as `(max-width: 720px)`. |


### usePageTitle

Sets the document title to “Page · Site name”, or “Site name: tagline” without a title.

```ts
import { usePageTitle } from '@/kit/hooks/usePageTitle'
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` |  | The page name. |

```tsx
usePageTitle('Dashboard')
```

### useFormat

Number, money, percent and date formatting that follows the locale and currency in the theme config.

```ts
import { useFormat } from '@/kit/lib/format'
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `locale` | `string` |  | makeFormatters: BCP 47 locale such as `tr-TR`. |
| `currency` | `string` |  | makeFormatters: ISO 4217 code such as `TRY`. |

```tsx
const fmt = useFormat()
fmt.money(12480.5)        // $12,480.50  (₺12.480,50 with tr-TR / TRY)
fmt.moneySigned(-45, 0)   // -$45
fmt.pct(2.4)              // +2.40%
fmt.date(new Date(), 'monthYear')
```

- Returns `money`, `moneyCompact`, `moneySigned`, `pct`, `num`, `compact`, `date`, `monthName` and `weekdayName`. Use `makeFormatters(locale, currency)` outside React.

### useText, useLang

Tiny translation helper. A screen defines `{ en: {...}, tr: {...} }` and picks the dictionary that matches the site locale.

```ts
import { useText, useLang, langOf } from '@/kit/lib/i18n'
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dict` *(required)* | `Record<Lang, T>` |  | One dictionary per language. |

```tsx
const TEXT = { en: { title: 'Cash flow' }, tr: { title: 'Nakit akışı' } }
const t = useText(TEXT)   // t.title follows the locale
```

- Languages are `en` and `tr`; a locale starting with `tr` selects Turkish, anything else English. Add a language in `kit/lib/i18n.ts`.

### Utilities

Small helpers: class names, safe storage, public asset URLs, dates and the seeded random generator.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cn` | `(...values) => string` |  | Joins class names, skipping falsy values (`kit/lib/cn.ts`). |
| `storage` | `{ get, set, remove }` |  | localStorage that never throws, e.g. in private windows (`kit/lib/storage.ts`). |
| `asset` | `(path: string) => string` |  | URL of a file in `public/` that respects the deploy sub-path (`kit/lib/asset.ts`). |
| `mulberry32` | `(seed: number) => () => number` |  | Seeded random numbers in [0, 1) (`kit/lib/random.ts`). |
| `date helpers` | `see source` |  | `today`, `addDays`, `addMonths`, `monthGrid`, `rangePresets` … local-time date arithmetic (`kit/lib/date.ts`). |
| `parseNumber` | `(text: string, locale: string) => number \| null` |  | Reads a number typed in the locale’s format (`kit/components/grid/gridUtils.ts`). |

```tsx
import { cn } from '@/kit/lib/cn'
<div className={cn('card', active && 'is-active')} />
```
